notes:
On a phone the writing gets the screen. The formatting controls ride above the keyboard instead of holding a row of their own, the font and the word counts moved to the Inspector, and the toolbar no longer slides under the status bar when the keyboard opens.

Settings on a phone shows one thing at a time: the list of sections, then the one you chose, with a way back. The first-run dialog puts its buttons where a thumb reaches, and the home screen leads with its actions instead of the epigraph.
